cases.name: binding-present-verifies-1of1
cases.note: single approver. Native artifacts contributed by the authorization-receipt format's author (I. Schrock, EMILIA Protocol) and independently reproduced. the artifact is a complete eight-member Trust Receipt carrying no caid and no @version; the digest is SHA-256 over the JCS bytes of the complete unchanged artifact, log_proof and approver_key_proofs included, and the identifier is derived only after verification under a relying-party-pinned mapping and never written back

cases.name: binding-present-verifies-2of3
cases.note: basic threshold: the same detailed format carrying distinct signoffs that satisfy the relying party's pinned quorum policy. There is no separate threshold receipt format

cases.name: binding-absent-does-not-invalidate
cases.note: an absent optional binding leaves the succession receipt valid, asserting no cross-format binding

cases.name: binding-without-native-artifact
cases.note: the binding is carried and proof-covered but its artifact was not supplied, so the cross-check did not run. This is NOT a pass: reading it as binding_verified is the misreading r2's equivalent case invited

cases.name: binding-quorum-suite-named-as-format
cases.note: EP-QUORUM-v1 names the quorum reference conformance suite, not a receipt carrier, so no verification procedure is registered for it

cases.name: binding-receipt-hash-mismatch
cases.note: the claimed receipt_hash does not match the recomputed complete-artifact digest

cases.name: binding-caid-mismatch
cases.note: the claimed caid does not match the identifier derived from the verified artifact under the pinned mapping. Evaluated after the digest, never before

cases.name: binding-log-proof-mutated
cases.note: log_proof changed. The native log leaf digest excludes this member, so a verifier hashing the leaf rather than the complete artifact passes this case — which is why it is here

cases.name: binding-approver-proofs-mutated
cases.note: approver_key_proofs changed. Excluded from the leaf digest for the same reason, and caught here for the same reason

cases.name: binding-native-caid-inserted
cases.note: the derived identifier written back into the signed artifact. The schema is closed, so this is refused as an inserted composition value rather than ignored as an unknown member
